The slope of the line of best fit for the LGBM model was closer to 1 than that of the RF model for both daytime and nighttime, indicating that the LGBM model had a better estimated AOD for a higher range compared to the RF model, which was generally underestimated.

Discussion and conclusions Utilizing datasets form CERES and MODIS satellites, we analyzed the spatial distribution and temporal trends of AOD and ADRF in the zonal region between 20 ◦ N and 40 ◦ N.
The results show that the spatial dis - tributions of ADRF and AOD are closely related. Aerosols cool the sur - face and heat the atmosphere, imposing a cooling effect at the top of the atmosphere.
